description: Atmospheric CO2 concentration from NOAA Mauna Loa Observatory — the Keeling Curve. Monthly readings in ppm (parts per million) since 1958. Returns last 10 years by default. Source: NOAA ESRL.

years.description: Number of years of data to return (1-50, default 10). Data is monthly.
